svg.title: Potential energy, without and with damping
svg.desc: A wireframe bowl encodes a virtual potential. An orange orbit conserves total energy. A teal trajectory spirals toward the goal while losing total energy. Dashed drops locate the actual configurations on the horizontal plane.
svg.text: Dots: t = 3 s. Curves: 0–8 s. Dashed drops locate q on the horizontal plane.
